Title: Pattern Matching Function is now available in Stream Analytics

Body.Content: With the new MATCH_RECOGNIZE function, you can easily define event patterns using regular expressions and aggregate methods to verify and extract values from the match. This enables to easily express and run Complex Event Processing (CEP) on your streams of data.
